items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Betty joined us after Ivie got so sick she couldn't travel no more. She joined us.

ctx.x: Betty Roche for a little while, too, didn't you?
Yeah, Betty joined us after Ivie got so sick she couldn't travel no more. She joined us. But Betty Roche never sang "Black Brown and Beige," you know.
